ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Crypto Mining Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects command line parameters or strings often used by crypto miners

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-cpu\\-priority\\=.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-donate\\-level\\=0.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-o\\ pool\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-nicehash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-algo\\=rx\\/0\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*stratum\\+tcp\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*stratum\\+udp\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*LS1kb25hdGUtbGV2ZWw9.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*0tZG9uYXRlLWxldmVsP.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*tLWRvbmF0ZS1sZXZlbD.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*c3RyYXR1bSt0Y3A6Ly.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*N0cmF0dW0rdGNwOi8v.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*zdHJhdHVtK3RjcDovL.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*c3RyYXR1bSt1ZHA6Ly.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*N0cmF0dW0rdWRwOi8v.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*zdHJhdHVtK3VkcDovL.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ pool\\\.c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ pool\\\.o\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*gcc\\ \\-.*")))
